stem.text: A shortage of protein in the diet of children can lead to a disease that causes excess tissue fluid to build up in the abdomen.
What explains why a build-up of excess tissue fluid can occur in this disease?

A.text: A shortage of plasma proteins decreases blood water potential; less tissue fluid returns to the blood.

B.text: A shortage of plasma proteins increases blood water potential; less tissue fluid returns to the blood.

C.text: A shortage of protein in the diet causes weak cardiac muscle, reducing hydrostatic pressure.

D.text: A shortage of protein in the tissue fluid decreases its water potential; more water leaves the blood.
